trans.sense: a coin-operated machine that plays recorded music

examples.text: Glenn Miller plays more sweet numbers than hot. His greatest success has been with the “juke boxes”, the nickel-in-a-slot automatic phonographs. Miller is easily the most outstanding juke-box artist of 1939.

"I love rock 'n roll
So put another dime in the jukebox, baby
I love rock 'n roll
So come and take your time and dance with me"
examples.ref: 1975 July, Alan Merrill, Jake Hooker, “I Love Rock 'n' Roll”, in I Love Rock 'n Roll, performed by Joan Jett and the Blackhearts, published January 1982:

glosses: A coin-operated machine that plays recorded music, with push-buttons to make selections.

examples.text: Before you export a movie to tape, double-check the following: Make sure all unnecessary programs are closed, including your e-mail program, MP3 jukebox, and Web browser.
examples.ref: 2011, Keith Underdahl, Adobe Premiere Pro For Dummies:

raw_glosses: (computing, by extension) A software application capable of replaying tracks from a digital music collection.
glosses: A software application capable of replaying tracks from a digital music collection.

raw_glosses: (computing) An automated carousel for the storage and retrieval of tapes, CD-ROMs, etc.
glosses: An automated carousel for the storage and retrieval of tapes, CD-ROMs, etc.

examples.text: Jukeboxes have frequently been compared to the megamusicals and are considered a direct offshoot.
